title: Units at Back-Alley Bar (Unsung Hero, Ravenbloom Student) are rendered in a tiny strip clipped off the bottom-right of the battlefield panel; they are essentially invisible and the monkey's clicks on board targets time out (steps 29 and 30 both TimeoutError).
expected: Screenshot 30.png shows Back-Alley Bar's player-side units as a ~20px sliver at the panel's bottom-right. Source: the fixed 1920x1080 logical board is over-subscribed (acknowledged in gameplay.css:143-144), so `.battlefield-row` collapses to `min-height: 180px` (gameplay.css:119) -> `.battlefield` ~156px with `overflow: hidden` (gameplay.css:915-927) -> `.bf-body` (padding 8px, header ~36px, divider) leaves ~45px per `.bf-units` side, which is `flex: 1 1 56px; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto` (gameplay.css:1143-1158), while `.bf-units .card` is `height: 126px` (gameplay.css:490-494). Board.js:133-139 renders units into those rows, so every battlefield unit is clipped to a thin scroll strip. Caveat: the claim's causal link to the step 29/30 TimeoutErrors is NOT supported — monkey-drive.ts:119-125 never enumerates .bf-units cards as click candidates (errors are `click:` on sidebar buttons), and the 'DOM shows 0 exhausted' invariant uses non-existent selectors `[id^="bf-"]`/`.bf-zone` (monkey-drive.ts:93). The layout/visibility defect itself is real.
